modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Lower the trunk by flexing all four legs together.
modes.minus: Return toward the nearly extended home height; upward travel from home is very limited.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Shift the trunk forward with a simultaneous lowering.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk backward with a simultaneous lowering.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Roll the trunk about positive x while lowering its right side.
modes.minus: Roll the trunk about negative x while lowering its left side.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_pitch_down
modes.plus: Pitch the front of the trunk downward while lowering.
modes.minus: Pitch the front of the trunk upward while lowering.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along pitch

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Yaw the trunk left while lowering.
modes.minus: Yaw the trunk right while lowering.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along yaw

modes.name: fl_foot_forward_up
modes.plus: Move the front-left foot forward and up.
modes.minus: Move the front-left foot backward and up.

modes.name: fl_foot_left_up
modes.plus: Move the front-left foot left and up.
modes.minus: Move the front-left foot right and up.

modes.name: fr_foot_forward_up
modes.plus: Move the front-right foot forward and up.
modes.minus: Move the front-right foot backward and up.

modes.name: fr_foot_right_up
modes.plus: Move the front-right foot right and up.
modes.minus: Move the front-right foot left and up.

modes.name: hl_foot_forward_up
modes.plus: Move the hind-left foot forward and up.
modes.minus: Move the hind-left foot backward and up.

modes.name: hl_foot_left_up
modes.plus: Move the hind-left foot left and up.
modes.minus: Move the hind-left foot right and up.

modes.name: hr_foot_forward_up
modes.plus: Move the hind-right foot forward and up.
modes.minus: Move the hind-right foot backward and up.

modes.name: hr_foot_right_up
modes.plus: Move the hind-right foot right and up.
modes.minus: Move the hind-right foot left and up.

modes.name: arm_tips_left
modes.plus: Sweep both finger tips left around the arm root.
modes.minus: Sweep both finger tips right around the arm root.

modes.name: arm_tips_up
modes.plus: Raise both finger tips with the shoulder.
modes.minus: Keep the shoulder at home; downward shoulder travel is blocked by the torso.

modes.name: arm_tips_back_up
modes.plus: Fold the arm tips backward and upward through the elbow.
modes.minus: Move the arm tips downward through a smaller elbow excursion.

modes.name: arm_tips_wrist_up
modes.plus: Rotate the distal arm upward and backward.
modes.minus: Rotate the distal arm downward and backward.

modes.name: arm_fingers_offset_up
modes.plus: Extend the right finger upward while keeping the left finger near home.
modes.minus: Extend the left finger downward while keeping the right finger near home.

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Shift the trunk left while lowering into flexed legs.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk right while lowering into flexed legs.

modes.name: arm_fingers_apart
modes.plus: Separate the finger tips approximately along base z.
modes.minus: Bring the finger tips slightly closer to their minimum separation.
